Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Package persistence.tools.spi

Interface SchemaValidatorFactory

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceLinterFactory, PersistenceServiceProvider
public interface SchemaValidatorFactory extends PersistenceLinterFactory
Factory for creating SchemaValidator instances.

Implementations are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism. Each implementation declares the persistence namespace it supports (e.g. "javax" or "jakarta") so that the correct validation strategy can be resolved for the target JPA specification version.

In JPMS environments, provider modules register their implementation with provides persistence.tools.spi.SchemaValidatorFactory in module-info.java.

Since:
2.1.0

    • newSchemaValidatorFactory

      static SchemaValidatorFactory newSchemaValidatorFactory(String jpaVersion)
      Discovers and returns the SchemaValidatorFactory implementation that matches the given JPA specification version using the thread context class loader.

      The version string is mapped to a persistence namespace ("javax" for versions 2.0–2.2, "jakarta" for versions 3.0–3.2) and the matching factory is located via the ServiceLoader API.

      Parameters:
      jpaVersion - the JPA specification version (e.g. "2.2" or "3.1")
      Returns:
      the factory implementation for the requested version
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version is not recognized
      IllegalStateException - if no provider is registered for the resolved namespace
